title: Bone Unmeal
description: A simple, lightweight Fabric mod that adds one new item: Bone Unmeal. It's the opposite of Bone Meal! Crafted with a piece of soul sand and a bone. Plus it has infinite uses!
body:
Bone Unmeal

A simple, lightweight Fabric mod that adds one new item: Bone Unmeal.

It's the opposite of Bone Meal!

What does it do?

Right-click on any crop (like wheat, carrots, or potatoes) to reduce its growth stage by one.

Affects a single block at a time, giving you perfect control.

Features infinite uses, with custom sounds and particle effects.

How to craft it:

1 Soul Sand Block + 1 Bone (Shapeless)
